tip.extraSub: For raiders who switch on some bosses: a third tank or an extra healer. Only a mark on the raider, the raid plan uses it later.
tip.playsAsSub: For raiders who play several specs: the third tank, an extra healer. The place is locked so a new proposal does not undo it.
tip.benchNever: Not on the bench in the last {count} raids
tip.pinnedSub: The panel stays with this raider until you release the selection — Esc or click them again.

requiredBuffs.label: Required buffs
requiredBuffs.tip: Buffs the raid template asks for.

mainSpec.label: Main spec
mainSpec.tip: Raiders on the spec they signed up with.

preferredCharacter.label: Preferred character
preferredCharacter.tip: Whoever lists several characters comes along with the first — a "can also bring" character costs this much.

fairness.label: Fairness
fairness.tip: Whoever sat on the bench last or often is more likely to come along. Only when fairness is on.

partyBuffs.label: Party buffs
partyBuffs.tip: Totems, auras and shouts in the group that need them.

wishes.label: Wishes
wishes.tip: "Happy to be with" in one group. Only when wishes are on.

avoid.label: Not together
avoid.tip: Penalty when a "not together" pair stands in the same group (parallel raids: in the same raid). Only when "not together" is on.

raidBuffs.label: Raid buffs
raidBuffs.tip: Every raid buff somebody in the raid brings.

roster.label: Roster status
roster.tip: Core before trial before bench, whoever is not in the roster after them. Only when the category has a roster.

status.approvedSubSince: Raiders see this setup · since {time}. Every change goes into the message right away.
status.changedSub: Raiders keep seeing the posted version until you post again.
status.changedSubSince: Raiders keep seeing the version from {time} until you post again.
status.draftSub: Raiders don't see anything yet. Only "Post setup" puts it in the channel, on the web and in the bot.
status.autoSub: Created by EventHelper at signup close. Check, adjust, post.
status.autoSubAt: Created by EventHelper at signup close ({time}). Check, adjust, post.

slot.lockedSub: A new proposal leaves this spot as it is. Click to unlock.
slot.lockSub: A new proposal should keep this spot.
slot.confirmSub: Sets the green check as if the raider had clicked "Confirm" — in the Discord message too.
slot.confirmedSub: Confirmed — click to take the check away.
slot.declinedSub: Cancelled — click to set the green check instead.

bench.empty: Nobody on the bench — drag raiders here.
bench.title: Bench
bench.tip: Only who was moved here by hand. Posted with the setup (and told per DM) only when “Post bench” is ticked.

pool.empty: Everybody signed up is in the setup.
pool.aria: Signed up, not in the setup
pool.title: Signed up
pool.tip: Signed up, but neither placed nor on the bench. Never posted. Drag people from here into a group or onto the bench.

summary.noRequired: No required buffs in the raid template.
summary.fairnessSub: Whoever sat on the bench last is more likely to come along in the next proposal.
summary.wishesSub: Raiders list in their profile whom they like to raid with. While this is on, the proposal puts such pairs into one group where it can. The default comes from the event or its raid template.

avoidSub.one: {count} pair of raiders would rather not raid together, per their profiles. On: separate groups (separate raids when raids run in parallel). Nobody sees who named whom.
avoidSub.other: {count} pairs of raiders would rather not raid together, per their profiles. On: separate groups (separate raids when raids run in parallel). Nobody sees who named whom.

summary.avoidTogetherSub: This many pairs still stand in the same group. "Propose again" separates them as far as it can.

askText.one: {count} pair of raiders would rather not raid together, per their profiles. Should the proposal put them into separate groups? Who named whom stays hidden – you can switch it any time in the side column.
askText.other: {count} pairs of raiders would rather not raid together, per their profiles. Should the proposal put them into separate groups? Who named whom stays hidden – you can switch it any time in the side column.

weightsModal.title: Weights
weightsModal.hint: Applies to the next proposal. Roles and raid size always come first.

explain.title: AI explanation
explain.hint: Only explains — it never changes the setup.
explain.noKey: Without an Anthropic key (Settings › Connections) there is no AI explanation.
explain.none: No explanation for this setup yet.

publishLine.postSub: Posts the approved setup to the event channel or updates the message there, and sends any DMs still missing. A draft is never posted.

search.title: Who are we still looking for?
search.hint: The message goes into the event channel (in English). You can change the numbers, specs and buffs, and the text by hand.
search.dropSub: Takes this buff out of the search.
search.none: Nothing is missing – roles and buffs are covered and every place is filled.

pingText.label: Ping message — posted when you click "Ping everyone"
pingText.title: Ping message
pingText.tip: The text every placed raider gets pinged with — both on "Ping everyone" in the channel and automatically on the first post of the approved setup. Leave empty for the default text.

readOnly.notApproved: The setup has not been approved yet.

bar.confirmedSub: Who in the groups has confirmed — with a click under the setup message, or by the organisers.

ping.buttonSub: Pings every raider in the groups in the event channel — with the ping message.

askText.one: {count} raider from the setup will be pinged in the event channel: “{text}”
askText.other: {count} raiders from the setup will be pinged in the event channel: “{text}”

more.reproposeSub: A new proposal from the signups — fixed places stay.

absent.one: {count} signed off · not part of the setup
absent.other: {count} signed off · not part of the setup

fill.autoSub: Spreads everybody signed up over groups and bench — by roles, buffs, attendance and fairness. You can move everything afterwards.
fill.freeSub: Fills the free places with raiders who signed up. Whoever stands stays — or let everything be proposed anew.

question.one: {count} raider is placed already. What should happen?
question.other: {count} raiders are placed already. What should happen?

keepText.one: Whoever stands stays. {count} free place is filled, the rest goes on the bench.
keepText.other: Whoever stands stays. {count} free places are filled, the rest goes on the bench.

fill.anewText: Only fixed raiders stay, everybody else is placed anew.

postOptions.aria: What is posted with the setup
postOptions.benchSub: On: the bench is in the setup message and the bench players get a DM. Off: the bench stays internal. Applies to the next "Post setup" and is remembered for this raid.
postOptions.dmsSub: On: everybody in the setup gets a DM with their place ("Group 2 as healer"), after a change only those whose place changed. Default from the category, applies to the next "Post setup".
postOptions.dmsSubOwn: Set differently for this raid than in the category. Applies to the next "Post setup" and is remembered for this raid.

live.holdsMsg: {name} is moving {character} right now. Wait a moment, then it works again.
live.editsMsg: {name} is editing {character}'s signup right now. Wait a moment, then it works again.
live.rebased: Somebody changed it in between — your move was applied to the new state.

askText.one: {count} raider in the groups has not answered yet and gets the green check — in the Discord message too. Who cancelled stays cancelled.
askText.other: {count} raiders in the groups have not answered yet and get the green check — in the Discord message too. Who cancelled stays cancelled.

editor.approveAnywayText: The setup doesn't pass every check (roles, size or required buffs). Once posted, raiders see it exactly as it is.
editor.approveSub: Posts the setup in the event channel — from then on it counts as approved and every change goes into the message right away.
editor.confirmAllSub: Sets the green check for everybody in the groups who has not answered yet. Who clicked "Cancel" stays cancelled. The Discord message follows.
editor.confirmAllNone: Everybody in the groups has answered already.
editor.moreSub: Propose anew, number of groups, ping text, fairness, wishes, compact, search, AI explanation and weights
editor.explainSub: Claude explains in a few paragraphs why the setup stands as it does.
editor.weightsSub: How much roles, buffs, attendance and fairness count in the proposal.
editor.placesSub: {count} of {size} spots filled · {bench} on the bench
editor.lockedSub: A new proposal keeps these spots.
editor.pickTarget: Pick a target — group, bench or raider · Esc
editor.sizeSub: Every group has 5 places, the raid's player count follows from that. Groups and bench change right away in the browser, applied when you leave the field or press Enter.
editor.sizeUnsavedTip: This number of groups has not been applied yet.
editor.searchSub: Which classes and specs the raid still needs – with a ready message for the channel.
editor.compactSub: Narrow cards with one-line raiders, for small screens. Remembered in this browser.

moves.respecBench: Someone on the bench has no place yet – drag them into a group first, then pick the spec.
moves.groupFull: Group {group} is full — drag onto a raider to swap.
moves.raidFull: The raid is full ({size}) — drag onto a raider to swap.

publish.offSub: DMs are turned on per category: Settings › Categories › Setup DMs.
publish.cancelledText: Cancelled — no setup in the channel
publish.cancelledSub: A cancelled event gets no setup posted and no DMs. A message already posted is marked as cancelled.
publish.draftNeverPosted: Raiders only see what is posted — before that the setup is a draft.
publish.editsExisting: The existing message is edited, not posted again.
publish.dmOnlyChanged: Only raiders whose spot changed since their last DM get a new one.
publish.notPostedSub: Posts the setup as its own message in the event channel.
publish.unchanged: {count} without a new DM — spot unchanged.
publish.outdated: The message still shows version {version} — "Post setup" updates it.
publish.liveSub: Changes to the setup update the message right away — no ping, no DMs. "Post setup" sends pending DMs.

signupEdit.openSub: Change status, character and spec as the orga (right-click works too).
signupEdit.hint: Deadline and profile do not bind the orga. Signup message and log follow, the place in the setup stays.
signupEdit.notInProfileHint: {spec} is not in {character}'s profile - applies to this raid only.
signupEdit.absenceHint: Signed off: leaves groups and bench and is no longer listed under "Signed up".
